scope: global and channel Tasks Board/List, filters, task mutations and source return, plus channel Files loading, failure, entry, source, and download contracts

interactionEvidence.taskCreateFailure: a forced local 503 kept the typed title in the modal, announced the error, changed the primary action to Retry, and persisted exactly one task after retry
interactionEvidence.taskClaim: the real claim API changed the QA task from todo to in_progress and cleared aria-busy after completion
interactionEvidence.taskStatusFailure: a forced status 503 restored only the affected task's prior status, exposed a retry alert, and retry persisted done without overwriting unrelated task updates
interactionEvidence.statusMenuKeyboard: focus entered the first menu item, ArrowDown moved to the next item, and Escape closed the menu and restored focus to the remounted task trigger
interactionEvidence.taskSourceReturn: global List opened the real source message with from=tasks; mobile removed primary navigation, exposed a 44px Back control in history mode, and returned to the preserved List view
interactionEvidence.taskLoadStates: two forced development-mode GET failures produced a stable retryable error; a 900ms response exposed three role=status lanes before the real task count returned
interactionEvidence.fileUpload: a 37-byte ignored QA text fixture uploaded through the real Composer, sent as a real message attachment, and appeared in Files with source and signed download links
interactionEvidence.fileLoadStates: two forced development-mode GET failures produced a stable retryable error; retry restored the real file row; a 900ms response exposed three aria-busy skeleton rows
interactionEvidence.fileMobileReturn: Files removed primary navigation, used deterministic replace-parent Back to the channel, and retained zero page-level overflow

permissionEvidence.tasks: channelAccess B1 and B4 prove private-channel list/create/convert/claim/status/unclaim/delete rejection while public-channel and owner paths remain operable
permissionEvidence.files: channelAccess B2 and B3 prove private and DM file-list/download rejection while public-channel, channel-member, and server-avatar paths remain operable
permissionEvidence.agentHandoff: human and Agent task-assignment integrations prove id, number, private-thread, and DM-thread handoff contracts

intentionalDifferences: OpenTag keeps its truthful local task, user, channel, attachment, and permission data rather than copying private Raft content.
OpenTag keeps signed attachment anchors and source-message navigation semantics even where Raft renders button-shaped controls.
Baseline hides the legacy board-layout toggle to match Raft while Classic retains the existing columns/stack preference as the rollback surface.
